messages:
alex: Heads-up - ZebraHealth flagged a missing day in their monthly export. Their 2024-10-15 data is absent from both the CSV and API export. Invoices show usage for 2024-10-15 though. CSV path: `s3://exports/zebrahealth/2024-10-15.csv` customer id: org_zzh_9001. Any immediate checks?

mira: Looking now. Can you confirm which export type (raw/hourly/agg) and paste the thread_ts for reference?

alex: Raw hourly export + consolidated CSV. thread_ts: 1743219876. I inspected the manifest — shard-12 has no object for that date. Billing ledger shows 12,300 tokens billed on 2024-10-15.

sam: I queried the ingestion topic — there was a gap in partition 3 around 2024-10-15T02:12Z. export-writer-3 logged `TimeoutError: write to s3 failed` then retries; eventually commit skipped. Snippet: `ERROR export-writer-3 2024-10-15T02:12:09Z Failed to upload part: 503`

mira: Can you check the export service manifest and the DLQ for shard-12? If we have raw ledger entries we can generate a synthetic hourly row and backfill the CSV, then update the manifest.

alex: DLQ has one `upload_failed` message for `hour_bucket=2024-10-15T02`. Plan: backfill from raw events -> regenerate hourly shard for 2024-10-15 -> PUT to s3 with `_backfill` suffix -> update manifest -> coordinate with billing to avoid double adjustments.

sam: I'll run reconcile to compute token counts from the raw ledger and output a patch CSV. ETA ~2 hours. tagging @billing-team to hold invoice adjustments for org_zzh_9001 until backfill completes.

billing-bot: @billing-team: invoice hold requested for org_zzh_9001 by sam. Status: pending.

mira: After backfill, run the validator: `python tools/validate_export.py --file s3://exports/zebrahealth/2024-10-15_backfill.csv --compare-ledger org_zzh_9001 --date 2024-10-15`

alex: Filed as support ticket #SUP-9238. I'll update the customer once backfill + validation is complete. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
